noah: FYI - bringing up artemis-38k-int3 on staging. After ~31k tokens of mixed short headers + long paragraphs we see a tiny KV index shift (single slot) and downstream token drift vs fp32. Repro + small logs below.

noah: minimal repro:
```
python -m tests.kv_onboard_repro --model artemis-38k-int3 --quant int3 --prefill tests/data/mix_headers_paragraphs.txt --max-tokens 31500 --kv-inspect --kv-dump 10:10
```

noah: trimmed log around failure:
```
idx=31210 fp_before=0x7d2b9a fp_after_prefill=0x7d2b9b (bump)
gen: mismatch at pos=31211 expected="ion" got="io"
```

tai: only on quantized variant?

noah: yes; fp32 matches baseline. suspect quant rounding interacting with RoPE phase at large offsets. Model cfg: `rotary_base=10000.0, pos_scale=1.015, rotary_interp=linear`. kv args default tiled: `--kv-tile 256 --kv-stride 32`.

emily: can you run with `--preserve-order` and `--kv-stride 1 --kv-tile 65536` (dense mapping)? If preserve-order fixes it, probably async prefetch merge ordering; if dense mapping fixes it, tiled slot arithmetic/collision likely.

noah: kicked off three variants (preserve-order, dense-map, nearest-interp). also added a compact dump that prints `idx,slot,key_hash,fp_before,fp_after,token_window`. ETA ~20m.

rachel: also try flipping `pos_scale` to 1.0 and 1.002 to see sensitivity. tiny scale changes can push rotary phase over an interpolation boundary at high pos.

tai: if dense-map fixes it, add runtime assert in tiled mapper to detect slot reuse and log `slot_owner` to help bisect. If preserve-order fixes it, we should add a deterministic-merge integration test.

merge-bot: Canary deploy: artemis-38k-int3 int3 -> staging started (canary-id: canary-20260803-7). Logs at /var/log/onboard/artemis/canary-7.log

noah: results incoming - will post trimmed CSV diffs here. keeping reproducer minimal for CI. thanks. :coffee:
